legal.draftBody: This text describes what the service does today. A lawyer has not approved it yet, and it may change before public launch. The approved text will carry a new version number.
legal.lawyer: To be completed with our lawyer before launch:

privacy.operatorHeading: Who is responsible for your data
privacy.processorsHeading: Service providers who process data for us
privacy.processorsIntro: These providers handle data on our behalf, only for the purpose shown. None of them may use it for their own purposes.
privacy.providerPending: Provider to be named before launch

razorpay.data: Payment details are entered with Razorpay; we receive payment ids, amounts and status

livekit.data: Call audio in transit, session ids

llm_provider.purpose: Horoscope prose drafts; AI assistant answers when enabled
llm_provider.data: Computed chart placements and the question (no name, phone or birth details)

retentionText.ledger_and_invoices: Kept as required by tax law even after account deletion (identity removed)
retentionText.kyc_documents: To be set with the lawyer

privacy.retentionNote: Proposed periods. They will be confirmed with our lawyer before launch.

refunds.rulesHeading: When a consultation is refunded automatically
refunds.rulesIntro: These rules run by themselves after every paid chat or call. You do not need to ask.

rules.failed_connect: The astrologer accepted but the consultation never started (for example, they did not join within {seconds} seconds): everything charged for it is refunded.
rules.astrologer_drop: The astrologer disconnected and did not come back within {seconds} seconds: the minutes that started after we last saw them are refunded. The minute in progress counts as served.
rules.low_rating: You rate the consultation 1 to {maxRating} stars within {hours} hours of its end: {percent}% of what you paid for it is refunded, up to {cap}. This applies to at most {perMonth, plural, one {# consultation} other {# consultations}} in any 30 days.
rules.service_unavailable: A call ended because our voice service could not confirm that both of you were present: the minutes after presence was last confirmed are refunded.

refunds.noRules: No automatic refund rules are switched on at the moment.

credit.spendOrderValue: Promo credit first (the lot that expires soonest goes first), then your recharged balance
credit.promoExpiryValue: {days} days after it is given, unless a different date is shown on the credit
credit.realExpiryValue: Period to be set before launch (current setting: {days} days, under review)
credit.freeOn: Currently offered: up to {minutes} minutes, once per person

safety.panelTitle: You don't have to face this alone
safety.panelBody: Please talk to someone who can help right now. The people at these numbers are trained to listen.
safety.endError: Could not end the consultation. Please try again.
safety.upsellPaused: We have stopped all offers and recharge reminders for this consultation. You can end it at any time; you pay only up to the current minute.
safety.notice: This is an astrology service, not a helpline.

consent.title: Before you continue
consent.intro: Consultations, payments, reports and the AI assistant are for adults. Please confirm the two points below.
consent.age: I am 18 years old or older.
consent.terms: I have read and agree to the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy notice</privacy>.
consent.under18: If you are under 18, you can keep using the free tools and horoscopes, but you cannot consult, pay or buy.
consent.updated: Our policies have changed since you last agreed. Please read and confirm the new version.

errors.age: Please confirm that you are 18 or older.
errors.terms: Please agree to the Terms of use and the Privacy notice.
errors.stale: The policies were updated a moment ago. Please confirm the new version shown above.
errors.signin: Your sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

report.title: Report {name}
report.intro: Tell our moderators what went wrong. The astrologer is not told who reported them.

reasons.scam: Scam or a request for money
reasons.medical_claims: Claimed to heal an illness or gave medical advice
reasons.off_platform: Asked to talk or pay outside this platform

report.noteHint: Up to {max} characters. Please don't include phone numbers or payment details.
report.sent: Thank you. A moderator will review your report. Astrologers who break the rules can be warned or suspended.

errors.note: Please keep the details to {max} characters.
errors.signin: Please sign in to report an astrologer.
errors.duplicate: You already have an open report about this astrologer. A moderator will look at it.
errors.network: Connection problem. Press Send again; the same report will be sent, not a second one.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

account.title: My account
account.intro: Your sign-in details, the policies you agreed to, and your data.
account.signIn: Sign in to see your account.
account.error: We could not load your account. Please try again in a minute.
account.consentsNone: You have not agreed to the policies yet.
account.consentsCurrent: Up to date with policy version {version}.
account.consentsOld: Policy version {version} is newer than what you agreed to.

export.heading: Download my data
export.body: Get a file (JSON) with everything we hold about you: profile, consents, saved kundlis, your consultations with your own chat messages, wallet history, reports, AI questions and answers, partner enquiries and reviews. Preparing it can take a few minutes. You can ask once every 24 hours.
export.queued: We are preparing your file. It will appear below.
export.tooSoon: You asked for a copy in the last 24 hours. Please try again later.
export.failedHelp: This file could not be prepared. Please ask again later.

deletion.heading: Delete my account
deletion.body: Deleting your account is permanent. Before we carry it out, any open consultation must end and any wallet balance must be settled.
deleted: Your sign-in sessions; your phone number is replaced so it can no longer identify you
Chat messages, AI questions and answers, partner enquiries
kept: Wallet ledger entries, as tax law requires; they no longer point to you
The record of what you agreed to, as proof of consent
deletion.again: You can sign up again with the same number later; it will be a new account.
deletion.pending: We received your request on {date}. Your account keeps working until it is carried out. You can cancel until then.
deletion.pendingNoDate: We received your request. Your account keeps working until it is carried out. You can cancel until then.

errors.confirm: Please type DELETE in capital letters to confirm.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
